#### Discussion Protocol (rounds per the shared Round budget)

Rounds follow `_common/agent-team-protocol.md`'s `### Round budget`; that section's ceiling is binding.

Round 2 hands each member its peer's proposal **by path** (`_common/agent-team-protocol.md` `## Multi-round`).

**Re-entry notes (MUST)**: directly above your `peer-read:` lines, put a section that starts with the heading `## Re-entry notes`, at most 20 lines.
